statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Nvidia-led premarket strength has re-broadened, but persistent no-retracement NQ structure is not verified.
recommendation: Tail is in WATCH; the main conditional risk concentration is the 12:30 UTC U.S. data cluster through the cash-open price-discovery window.
headline: Nvidia-led premarket strength re-broadens before U.S. data
body: Fresh Reuters reporting has Nasdaq-100 futures about 0.8% higher and NVIDIA 6.7% higher premarket, with European technology shares stronger, oil lower and the U.S. 10-year yield easing. Broader equity participation remains mixed, so the evidence supports WATCH rather than a block.

lookbackSummary: Tail was low before Wednesday's macro releases and NVIDIA earnings, rose to WATCH during the delayed earnings-call reversal, peaked at 24% at 02:00 UTC Thursday, and then eased. No published assessment exists for 06:00 UTC Thursday.
outlookSummary: NVIDIA-led premarket strength has re-broadened, lifting current Tail into WATCH. Conditional risk is concentrated around the 12:30 UTC U.S. data cluster and cash open, with Marvell's 20:45 UTC call a secondary semiconductor checkpoint.

forecast.analysis: Observed Nasdaq-100 futures are up about 0.8% and NVIDIA is up 6.7% premarket; softer oil and easing yields support risk, but broad equity participation remains mixed.

forecast.analysis: If NVIDIA-led strength remains concentrated rather than broadening, Tail should stay near WATCH despite positive futures.
U.S. premarket liquidity increases before the 12:30 UTC data cluster; persistent index extension without meaningful retracement would be the key Tail amplifier.
The 12:30 UTC claims and advance trade/inventory releases create a high-stress checkpoint. A fast two-way response would favor whipsaw rather than pathological trend.
Post-data price discovery into the cash open is the strongest conditional risk window; repeated extension after failed pullbacks would keep Tail in WATCH.
The U.S. cash open is the critical efficiency test. Sustained opening-auction continuation with shallow retracements would push Tail toward the block threshold.
The first full cash hour should distinguish continuation from mean reversion. Broader participation plus weak pullbacks would keep Tail elevated within WATCH.
If opening volatility decays and two-way trade returns, Tail should ease; holding near session extremes would keep residual WATCH risk.
Late-morning structure remains conditional on whether early direction survives retracement tests; normalized breadth would reduce directional risk.
By midday, ordinary two-way liquidity would move Tail below WATCH; only repeated extension with shallow pullbacks would preserve trend risk.
A quieter midday is expected conditionally if cross-asset pressure stays contained; renewed semiconductor breadth would be the main upside amplifier.
Late-session risk rises modestly ahead of Marvell's semiconductor results and 20:45 UTC conference call, but the event alone does not imply one-way structure.
Marvell's 20:45 UTC call creates a semiconductor repricing window. Tail would stay in WATCH unless a broader NQ continuation develops with weak retracements.
Post-call trade should be judged by whether any semiconductor impulse broadens to the index. Fast retracement would lower the risk of a persistent path.
After the late-session catalyst, Tail should fall below WATCH if volatility compresses and the index stops holding directional extremes.
Early Asia is conditionally low Tail if U.S. closing structure normalizes; residual AI sentiment may keep Stress above a quiet-session baseline.
Thin overnight liquidity favors caution in interpretation, but Tail remains low unless directional efficiency persists across the Asia handoff.
Without a fresh catalyst, two-way overnight trade would keep Tail low; renewed gap extension would be the main exception.
Late Asia remains a low-Tail window conditionally if technology leadership does not broaden into persistent index-level extension.
The Europe handoff should test whether any overnight AI impulse is durable; ordinary retracements would keep Tail low.
Early European participation is expected to remain a confirmation window rather than a standalone Tail catalyst absent one-way NQ structure.
As European liquidity deepens, aligned semiconductors and broad equities would matter more than isolated headline strength.
Friday premarket preparation begins to reflect Jackson Hole sensitivity, but scheduled policy risk primarily raises Stress until price-path evidence appears.
Approaching the final forecast hour, policy-event sensitivity increases ahead of Chair Warsh's later Jackson Hole remarks; Tail remains below WATCH absent persistent structure.
